programme.title: Twenties: What Would Todd Do?
programme.desc: I improvisasjonstimen kjemper Nia med å få stereotype svarte roller. Marie blir rasende over Ben blir forfremmet foran henne, og leter etter svar. Hattie prøver å gjøre sin stemme hørt i forfatterrommet.

programme.title: Twenties: Living The Dream
programme.desc: I et modig forsøk på å gi Nia en rolle i Cocoa's Butter, blir Hattie sparket fra serien. Marie avholder en spesiell fødselsdagsmiddag som får en vri når en uventet gjest dukker opp.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: One Is The Loneliest Number
programme.desc: Mary Jane og kollegene rystes av en dødelig skoleskyting i Atlanta.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Line In The Sand
programme.desc: Mary Jane blir nominert for Emmy-prisen, og må søke råd hos gode venner. Tidsnok må hun bestemme seg for å ta sjansen og følge instinktet. Samtidig blir informasjon om Tracy kjent.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Primetime
programme.desc: Cynthia er syk og Mary Jane og Kara leder og produserer et nyhetsprogram i beste sendetid. Av andre begivenheter velger Paul jr. arbeidstilbud.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night One
programme.desc: Livene til fem barndomsvenner fra Roxbury-prosjektet i Massachusetts endrer seg for alltid når de danner en sanggruppe for å vinne en lokal talentkonkurranse. Til slutt blir de det legendariske R&B-bandet New Edition.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Reading The Signs
programme.desc: Mary Janes fraser blir virale og gjør henne til en sensasjon over natten. Sheldon kjemper med å ta forholdet deres til neste nivå. Kara drar for å hjelpe til med et komplisert familieproblem.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Signing Off
programme.desc: Mary Jane Paul virker å ha alt; intelligens, driv, et pent hjem, sportsbil og en overdådig garderobe med designersko. Tross det mangler noe i hennes amerikanske drøm - en egen familie.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Facing Fears
programme.desc: Mary Jane hastes på sykehus etter ulykken og familien flokkes rundt henne. Paul sr. håndterer David og Helen befrir dem for Lisa. Kara kjemper for Mary Jane på SNC.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Two
programme.desc: Though New Edition become R&B sensations, their fame comes at a steep price as internal tension and external pressure leads them to put business before friendship.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Louie Louie
programme.desc: Mary Jane sitter hjemme uten noe å gjøre, men får nye problemer da Cece avslører sine planer for å utpresse henne. SNC ansetter Marisol, en het, ny, ung latinererstatning.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Sparrow
programme.desc: Da Mary Jane fikk de knusende nyhetene om en kjær venns død, tvinges hun til å konfrontere sine livsvalg, håndtere familien og møte David.

programme.title: Boomerang: Pilot
programme.desc: New age markedsføringsproffene Bryson Broyer og Simone Graham vil skape sine egne spor for å lykkes samtidig som de vil ivareta foreldrenes arv: Graham-agenturet. En gang et firma som definerte industrien, men har mistet sin glans.

programme.title: Boomerang: Game Night
programme.desc: Bryson arrangerer en spillekveld for gjengen, men moroa forvandles snart til sjalusi når Simone konsentrerer seg om en uventet gjest. David og Crystal treffer hverandre for første gang siden skilsmissen.

programme.title: Boomerang: Power
programme.desc: Bryson prøver å få Victoria til å markedsføre en svart avantgardefilm. Simone leter etter muligheter for at Tia skal bygge varemerket sitt. Bryson tar tilbake makten fra Simone.

programme.title: Boomerang: Call A Spade
programme.desc: Simone, Crystal og Tia drar på en nattlig jentetur for å redde Simones sorgløse bestevenninne og kjæresten fra fengsel. Simone tar også hånd om sin skyld over Crystal og Davids skilsmisse.

programme.title: Games People Play: Pilot
programme.desc: Nia blir forfremmet og flytter til Los Angeles, og forlater kjæresten Eric i New York. Vanessa og baskemannen Marcus kjøpes til Los Angeles med nyheten om at dama han hadde en affære med nå er borte.

programme.title: Games People Play: Lover's Moon
programme.desc: Nia intervjuer Laila om historien. Laila bekrefter at mannen på bildene er Marcus King. Nia informerer Vanessa om artikkelen som holder på å bli utgitt. Kareem forteller Marcus at Jamal sliter med spillegjeld.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Drink of Kings
programme.desc: Marcus og Vanessa gå til rådgiver. Nia og MJ kjemper for å komme seg etter tapet av Laila-historien. Laila arrangerer privatfester for Roxanne og blir venn med Susie Q. Susie inviterer Laila til en snobbete begivenhet.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mixed Messages
programme.desc: En sannhet om Andre slår Mary Jane, og hun svarer med å møte en mann på nettet. Forandringer blir for mye for Mark. Helens diamantarmbånd forsvinner. Elte følelser angående Patterson-barna kommer for en dag.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Exposed
programme.desc: Paul sr. vil glede Helen med et platinabord uner en stor galla, hvor Mary Jane tilfeldigvis treffer David. MJ må fatte en stor avgjørelse på arbeidet.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Hindsight is 20/40
programme.desc: Et bilde skaper dramatikk mellom Mary Jane og Andre. Patrick meddeler at han flytter ut. Et dopkjøp blir voldsomt. Niecy kommer med en plan som følger hennes leveranse. Kara grubler over fordelingen av sønnene sine.

programme.title: Boomerang: The Let Out
programme.desc: Ari inviterer gjengen ut når han er vert for en fest på en av Atlantas heiteste nattklubber. Der prøver Simone å få Tias nye singel spilt av en DJ. I en uventet vri, kysser Bryson og Simone hverandre for første gang.

programme.title: Boomerang: Homecoming
programme.desc: I en flashbackepisode utforskes Bryson og Simones forhold fra barndom til college, når de konkurrerer om hverandres følelser. Ari, Tia, Crystal og David gjør djerve fremstøt, noe som får livene deres på nåværende kurs.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vær alle mine synder husket
programme.desc: En kroppsidentifikasjon går galt når det viser seg at Bekas tidligere mannskap ikke er død.

programme.title: Mutant X: The Grift
programme.desc: Brennans skyggefulle ekskjæreste henvender seg til ham for å få hjelp når hennes siste svindel tar en dødelig vending.

programme.title: Mutant X: At Destiny's End
programme.desc: Teamet står overfor sitt farligste oppdrag ennå: å stoppe en gruppe øko-terrorister.

programme.title: Mutant X: Within These Walls
programme.desc: Brennan er opprørt over Adam, som forteller ham at han ble betrodd å holde hemmeligheten og drar etter å ha snakket med den personen. Mannen leter etter noen og er villig til å drepe alle for å komme til den personen.

programme.title: Mutant X: Hard Time
programme.desc: Teamet går undercover for å undersøke uforklarlige dødsfall i fengselet.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Reel Thing
programme.desc: Arbeidet som konsulenter for en arkeologisk eventyrfilm, innser Sydney og Nigel at farao Amun IIs 'rekvisitter' er ekte, lenge tenkte tapte relikvier. Hvordan kan de være?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Claudia oppdager at hun var Cleopatras tjener i et tidligere liv da hun opplever déjà vu mens hun så på en katalog fra en antikkegyptisk relikvieutstilling.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Eyes of Toklamanee
programme.desc: Sydney og studenten Adam er på forfedrenes fantastiske Eyes of Toklamanee, men de forfølges av mystiske våpenmenn.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Run Sydney Run
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i bakhold i Russland. To uker senere våkner Sydney i huset til en mann som heter Tsarlov, som hevder å ha reddet henne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Mayflies dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drift, men de blir snart til zombier som blir kontrollert av en bikube.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himmelen er nå tre
programme.desc: Motoren til skapelsen er i stand til å omskrive universet i henhold til eierens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må skaffe det før noen med mørke planer får det.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ting vi ikke kan endre
programme.desc: Et svart hull slår Dylan ut og sender ham inn i en alternativ virkelighet med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Fair Unknown
programme.desc: Mannskapet redder en av de tapt grunnleggerne av Commonwealth, men oppdager at hun kan være mer trøbbel enn hun er verdt.

programme.title: Mutant X: Under the Cloak of War
programme.desc: Shalimar blir sendt undercover i en dødelig høyteknologisk attentatring, for å finne hvorfor de vil ha Adam død.

programme.title: Mutant X: Once Around
programme.desc: Teamet går inn for å beskytte det viktigste påtalevitnet hvis liv har blitt truet før rettssaken.

programme.title: Mutant X: Final Judgement
programme.desc: En mystisk domstol finner Adam skyldig i å ha prøvd å dominere verden med sine supermutanter og dømmer ham til døden, og har sendt resten av teamet på oppdrag for å redde ham.

programme.title: Mutant X: Inferno
programme.desc: Teamet er på sporet av en pyromanmutant som forårsaker kaos, mens Shalimar blir tvunget til å sette av sin frykt for ild for å redde Emma.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: M.I.A.
programme.desc: Sydney blir kidnappet, men av hvem? Nigel, Claudia og Cate blir nødt til å gå gjennom listen over fiender Sydney har laget tidligere og utlede hvem av dem som er ansvarlige. Cue tilbakeblikk.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Don't Go Into the Woods
programme.desc: Sydneys venn ringer for å informere henne om at han har oppdaget informasjon om Golden Hawk of Maribor, tapt siden 1711. Sydney og Nigel reiser til Lubjanka for å møte ham, men han er allerede borte.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: French Connection
programme.desc: Mens hun var på en forelesningstur med Nigel i Europa, blir Sydney kontaktet av MI5 fordi hun er den eneste som kan forhindre et forestående attentat på høyt nivå.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Midnight Flight
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 e.Kr.: en gjenstand kalt Gunther's Scepter er forseglet i et hvelv. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney og Nigel blir ansatt for å finne det ved hjelp av en krystall og en steintavle.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Twenty aspiring restaurateurs present their signature dishes to Ramsay -- and an audience -- in Las Vegas; while the challenge winners earn a night out on the town, the losers must head back to Los Angeles on a school bus.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The contestants arrive at the dorms; Ramsay sends contestants out of the kitchen after a rocky first dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The 19 remaining chefs immediately become 18 after a dramatic walkout from one of the hopefuls. Despite Gordon attempting to teach the group about teamwork with an army-led physical challenge, a disastrous food service leads to another elimination.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Olympic athletes Maurice Greene, Natalie Coughlin and Danell Leyva help Ramsay lead a 3K race, with the red and blue teams racing to prepare lunch for the runners; communication issues lead to fights during the dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The teams must identify the type of protein used in five dishes; as the winning team enjoys its victory at a beach house, the losing team must grind and mill grains to make bread from scratch; contestants are grilled during elimination.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Ramsay makes a decision that changes the competition; two chefs work as servers during the dinner service; each team nominates two contestants to be put up for elimination.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Chef Martin Yan judges six Chinese dishes created by the remaining contestants; during dinner service, one team disappoints a VIP guest; a contestant is eliminated.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The contestants enter an animal pen to determine which type of protein they will cook in the team challenge; during dinner service, the contestants must impress chef Ramsay's family.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The teams must create five steak dishes; a diner finds an unpleasant surprise in her dish during dinner service; the elimination round brings out bad tempers.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay puts two teams of wannabe chefs through a series of gruelling challenges as they battle for the ultimate prize of a head chef position at his Las Vegas restaurant. The two teams are challenged to throw a party fit for a princess.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs compete to participate in a photo shoot and host a dinner for members of the Army.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The two teams must create their own menus for the evening service. Despite a lacklustre selection, the female team threatens to outshine the men when it comes to food service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chefs create ethnic dishes with select ingredients; a team falls behind before dinner service begins.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Ramsay tests the chefs' palates with a blind taste test; Ramsay presents an unexpected challenge in order to determine who gets immunity.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The chef with the best dish earns immunity; the chefs prepare a meal for TV host Maria Menounos and actor Jeremy Sisto; one team's service flags during dinner.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Ramsay tests the contestants' ability to communicate and work together with a three entrée relay race, with the winners getting a helicopter tour and a caviar tasting.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Gordon reunites the contenders with their loved ones before challenging them to jazz up some basic cuts of meat.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: A team of previous winners returns to challenge the remaining contestants; each team designs its own menus for dinner service.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The final five chefs must impress tough critics with a gourmet burger; a huge misstep brings dinner service to a halt; one chef is eliminated.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: With the grand finale just around the corner, the remaining chefs are challenged to replicate a sample dish using taste, texture and sight alone. The winner is rewarded with a $1,000 shopping spree before another taxing evening service begins.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Top Gear-gutta prøver å bevise at biler kan være mer populære enn tradisjonell kunst - ved å arrangere en motorutstilling i Middlesbrough.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 7
programme.desc: Til tross for at produsentene krever at de holder seg innenfor budsjettet, utfører James den dyreste biltesten i Top Gears historie med en BMW X6.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1
programme.desc: James kjører opp en aktiv vulkan på Island i en Toyota Hilux, og Richard gir Chevrolet Lacettien en verdig avskjed.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Jeremy, Richard og James finner den beste bilen for å ta familien med på handletur med et budsjett på 5000 pund.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3
programme.desc: Gutta prøver å finne verdens beste fireseters superbil, og Harry Potter-stjernen Rupert Grint er ukens kjendis i billigbilen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Top Gear-gutta bygger tøffe og interessante bobiler før de setter kursen mot Sørvest-England for en langhelg.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 5
programme.desc: Tom Cruise og Cameron Diaz er ukens kjendiser i en billigbil, og James May forsøker å slå sin egen fartsrekord i en Bugatti Veyron.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 6
programme.desc: Gutta tar et vemodig tilbakeblikk på restene av Storbritannias sportsbilindustri, og Jeff Goldblum prøver seg i billigbilen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 7
programme.desc: Gutta tar en storslått kjøretur langs USAs østkyst i en Mercedes SLS, en Porsche 911 GT3 RS, og en Ferrari 458 Italia.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 1

programme.sub-title: Hvem er redd for Amanda Woodward?

programme.title: Melrose Place: En helt ny dag
programme.desc: Craig klandrer Samantha for ulykken som drepte Sydney og faren hennes. Og en ny kirurg begynner å jobbe med Michael på Wilshire Hospital.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Den trojanske stork
programme.desc: Cooper flytter inn i Matts tomme leilighet i Melrose og begynner å snoke i beboernes liv, blant annet Michaels forhistorie med Kimberly.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ingen tid til sædbanker
programme.desc: Når Taylors såkalte "graviditet" blir et problem, ber hun Michael gjøre henne gravid og bevise at hun er gravid.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Legen er inne... dypt inne
programme.desc: Samantha tilstår at hun kom til å fortelle om Billy og Amandas nye reklamebyrå, mens Craig vedgår nederlag.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Desperat etter Samantha
programme.desc: Sydneys far kommer til Los Angeles for å besøke Craig. Senere åpner Amanda Woodward Advertising med Amanda som daglig leder og Eric som investor.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Et lys i enden av fallet
programme.desc: Peter får vite om Coopers forbindelse til avdøde Kimberly Shaw: Han er legen som behandlet henne etter ulykken.
programme.sub-title: Et lys i enden av fallet

programme.title: Melrose Place: Hemmeligheter og koner
programme.desc: Etter at Lexi tar kontroll over Coopers kontoer, beskylder han Michael for å fortelle henne om de skjulte aktivaene.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Et skudd i mørket
programme.desc: Peter erklærer sin kjærlighet til Lexi, og hun flytter inn hos ham. Jennifer hjelper Crai med å selge Mancini Glove.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Skalpellkvinnens angrep
programme.desc: Etter at Cooper slipper ut av fengsel, følger Megan ham rundt og oppdager at Kimberlys mor står bak drapsforsøket på Michael.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Min lille komajente
programme.desc: Cooper fortsetter å våke ved sengekanten mens Megan er i koma. Men en sjalu Michael prøver å stoppe besøkene etter en følelse av déjà vu.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Alle drar til Kyle
programme.desc: Billy og Samantha drar på bryllupsreise til Hawaii, mens Connie får en vikarjobb ved Amanda Woodward Advertising og bestemmer seg for å bli i Los Angeles.

programme.title: Melrose Place: En lyd i mørket
programme.desc: Etter å ha reddet Lexie, vender Peter tilbake til ulykkesstedet og finner en landstryker som Lexi kjørte på da hun kjørte Peters bil.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Et tre snakker i Melrose
programme.desc: Cooper avbryter Michaels jakt på Megan. Jennifer får også Cooper til å droppe søksmålet mot Michael.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Å drepe et helikopter
programme.desc: Etter å ha gjemt jazzklubbens julemidler, tar Taylor Kyle med på en helgetur til Las Vegas for å gamble og gjør et stort innhugg i gjelden.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Amanda er tilbake
programme.desc: Billy og Kyle presser et redningsteam til å sette i gang en leteaksjon etter Samantha og Amanda, som kan ha fått en alvorlig skade.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ørkenens Kyle
programme.desc: Cooper og Megan går på date, og Michael prøver å gjøre det samme med stripperen Amber. Bob spiller sin hånd med Peter for å være med Lexi.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Ikke stol på noen
programme.desc: Når fem millioner dollar forsvinner fra bevislageret, blir Trivette beskyldt for å ha stjålet dem.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Blåfilmer
programme.desc: Walker må være kreativ for å fakke en høyt respektert samfunnsleder.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: På hellig grunn
programme.desc: En gjeng unge cherokee-indianere går berserk og raner museer og stjeler artefakter.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Avsluttet sak
programme.desc: Alex finner en traumatisert jentunge som påstår at faren ble tatt til fange av "himmelfolket".

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Tilbakeblikk
programme.desc: Når en gullgraver blir drept etter å ha gravd opp en skatt som hadde vært forsvunnet siden 1860-tallet, blir Walker ledet ut i ørkenen av ånden til den legendariske Texas Ranger Hays Cooper for å avsløre sannheten om forsvinningen til det skjulte gullet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Stillingskrig, del 1
programme.desc: En berømt internasjonal leiemorder blir hyret inn av en fengslet narkobaron for å drepe en meksikansk presidentkandidat, og Walker og Trivette får i oppdrag å beskytte ham under besøket i Texas.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Sprengt i filler
programme.desc: En fange på rømmen vil drepe alle som var ansvarlige for å sende ham i fengsel. Han angriper dem én etter en og sparer Walker til slutt.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Dyp spaning
programme.desc: Med hestehale, en italiensk silkeskjorte og en lekker sportsbil samarbeider Walker med en vakker spaner i Miami for å ta en narkobaron.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Beskytterne
programme.desc: To arbeidere dør på en oljerigg i Texas i merkelige ulykker. Walker spaner for å finne ut hvem som saboterer riggene og hvorfor.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Kollisjonskurs
programme.desc: Walker og C.D. haster for å redde C.D.s niese når hun kidnappes av ekskjæresten som tvinger henne med på bankran som en slags nåtidens Bonnie og Clyde.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Poeng etter
programme.desc: Etter noen tvilsomme avgjørelser på kamp blir treneren for fotballaget ved en skole i en småby i Texas drept, men Walker og Trivette tror ikke han ble drept av sinte fans.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Nattens ondskap
programme.desc: I sinne overfor den hvite mann for å ha forstyrret en urgammel indianergravplass står en ond medisinmann opp fra de døde for å terrorisere de ansvarlige.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Endelig rettferd
programme.desc: Når han oppdager at en av mennene som drepte foreldrene hans aldri ble stilt for retten, finner Walker et vitne og leter etter gjerningsmannen.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Lynsjing
programme.desc: Når en småbymobb klandrer en gutt for drapet på en godt likt kvinne og medborger, kalles Walker inn for å hindre mobben i å lynsje gutten mens han prøver å bevise hans uskyld.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Rafting, del 1 / Rafting, del 2
programme.desc: Alex tar Walker med på raftingtur, men ferien tar en dødelig vending.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Pakten
programme.desc: Walkers beste karateelev fra en skole i sentrum blir med i en gjeng for å hevne broren som ble skutt. Walker prøver å stoppe den meningsløse krigen og bringe fred til det splittede nabolaget i julen.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Robert legger ut på en dristig redningsaksjon av erkefiendens enke, Sasha. Men snart blir Robert konfrontert med et kjent ansikt han trodde han aldri ville se igjen...

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Etter en romantisk kveld i deres avsidesliggende hus, våkner Emma opp lenket til sin døde ektemann. Hun er fanget og isolert og må kjempe mot leiemordere for å unnslippe ektemannens avsindige plan.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere agenten Bryan Mills begynner de lengste 96 timene i sitt liv når han tar opp jakten på mennene som kidnappet datteren hans.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie vender tilbake til den lille hjembyen sin da hun uventet blir verge for niesen og nevøen sin. Der møter hun Cooper, kjæresten fra high school.

programme.title: Worth
programme.desc: Etter angrepene på World Trade Center og Pentagon utnevner kongressen advokaten Kenneth Feinberg til å lede erstatningsfondet for ofrene. Feinberg står overfor en umulig oppgave - å bestemme hvor mye et liv er verdt.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: 16-år gamle Megan Walsh er i trening for å bli en iskald internasjonal leiemorder, men i hemmelighet lengter hun etter å være en normal tenåring. Hun forfalsker derfor sin egen død.

programme.title: The Vows We Keep
programme.desc: En eventplanlegger finner kjærligheten mens hun jobber med å arrangere det siste bryllupet på en historisk taverna.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Bryan Mills og hans kone er i Istanbul når de blir bortført. Mannen som holder dem som gissel viser seg å være far til en av de mennene som tidligere kidnappet Mills datter, og under frigjøringen av datteren ble han drept.

programme.title: Wildfire: Commitment Issues
programme.desc: When it appears that Flame is ready for his first race, Kris decides to fight to get her jockey's license reinstated.

programme.title: Wildfire: Life's Too Short
programme.desc: Kris hopes that Flame's success in the DuPont Stakes might help Jean change her mind about Raintree's future, but Kris isn't so sure about what part---if any---she'll play in it.

programme.title: Wildfire: Vows
programme.desc: Kris and Junior hastily decide to get married, but they're forced to postpone their plans when Jean is injured by one of the horses rescued by Matt.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Comeback
programme.desc: With Jean still out of commission, Kris and Matt do their best to run the dude ranch at Raintree while also preparing for the next race, which features Dani's new horse in the field

programme.title: Wildfire: Being Mrs. Junior
programme.desc: Universal disapproval of Kris and Junior's wedding plans has everyone on edge, and even Kris wonders if she has what it takes to be part of the Davis family.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Ties That Bind: Part 1
programme.desc: Kris and Junior consider a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to relocate to Alaska for a year to work on a geothermal project in the series' penultimate episode.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Ties That Bind: Part 2
programme.desc: In the series finale, Junior's schedule goes haywire when an urgent matter in Alaska that requires his attention coincides with Kris'ride on Wildfire in the Tucker Stakes and their wedding.

programme.title: Wildfire: Pilot
programme.desc: Kris Furillo is released from the juvenile detention center and begins working at the Ritter family ranch.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Rescue
programme.desc: Kris Furillo is released from the juvenile detention center and begins working at the Ritter family ranch.

programme.title: Wildfire: Trust
programme.desc: Kris returns to Raintree Ranch after ninety days at Camp Lagrange and begins the healing process.

programme.title: Wildfire: Mothers
programme.desc: Kris' mother Barb pays an unexpected visit to Raintree.

programme.title: Wildfire: Try It Without The Porsche
programme.desc: Kris meets Kerry Connelly, a sports agent who takes interest in Kris after the results of the Sandpiper Race.

programme.title: Wildfire: Opportunity Knocks
programme.desc: On the heels of her dramatic second place finish in the Sandpiper Race, Kris is offered an opportunity to star in a commercial with Wildfire, which unexpectedly thrusts Kris and Junior together.

programme.title: Wildfire: A Good Convict Is Hard To Find
programme.desc: Kris reluctantly returns to Camp LaGrange for an event at the Equestrian Center where she first met Wildfire.
programme.sub-title: A Good Convict Is Hard To Find

programme.title: Wildfire: Dangerous Liaisons
programme.desc: Kris is left alone in charge of Raintree when Jean goes on a trip with Charlie, Matt goes with Dani to help her look into a new racehorse, and Pablo investigates a mysterious phone call.

programme.title: Wildfire: Family Matters
programme.desc: With Pablo away, Matt trains Kris for her first turf race on Wildfire while simultaneously secretly training Wildfire's competition, Dani's horse Picaro.

programme.title: Wildfire: Nothing Takes The Past Away Like The Future
programme.desc: When Raintree takes on a well-known horse to train, Kris and Matt work together to figure out the horse's problem, only to discover the real reason Pablo wants nothing to do with it.
programme.sub-title: Nothing Takes The Past Away Like The Future

programme.title: Wildfire: Taking Off
programme.desc: Kris learns a lesson in the jockey life as she works under a renowned but demanding trainer.

programme.title: Wildfire: Fear
programme.desc: Kris must turn to Junior for help when she is asked to throw a race by John Zack, the figure from Pablo's past.

programme.title: Wildfire: Break Down
programme.desc: Kris finds herself racing Dani's horse Picaro against Wildfire, as the result of a promise she made.

programme.title: On the Case: Lost In The Fire
programme.desc: When a pregnant mother of two is found shot to death in her fire-ravaged home, police find there are more suspects than clues.

programme.title: On the Case: Predator on the Loose
programme.desc: A deadly predator haunts the city of Stockton, California and becomes more and more violent.

programme.title: On the Case: Mystery In The Desert
programme.desc: When an innocent couple is murdered execution-style in the Arizona desert it marks the beginning of a 50-year search for the truth. Who really killed them and why? After decades of investigation, the controversial case remains shrouded in mystery.

programme.title: On the Case: Snapshot to Murder
programme.desc: A high school student vanishes into thin air during a day studying in the park. Will a photograph from a nearby celebration help solve the case?

programme.title: On the Case: A Face with No Name
programme.desc: Police have DNA evidence and a videotape of their suspect, yet they still struggle to find a vicious killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Silence
programme.desc: An 18-year-old woman never returns home after a night out with friends, and the police come up against a wall of silence that keeps them from uncovering the truth.

programme.title: On the Case: A Window to Murder
programme.desc: A valiant teenager's dying act helps police solve the mystery behind her murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder At Sunset- Part 2
programme.desc: A mother and two daughters are discovered floating in Tampa Bay after a brutal triple homicide. Police must rely on a victim who survived a similar attack to bring the killer to justice in this special two-hour On the Case.

programme.title: On the Case: This is for Her
programme.desc: A deadly home invasion leaves a father of three dead. Why was the victim's wife, the only eyewitness to the crime left alive?

programme.title: On the Case: Almost Home
programme.desc: A young woman's battered body is found on the side of the road. The shocking evidence from the crime leads police down a trail of tragedy.

programme.title: On the Case: Profile of a Killer
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman is found murdered in the basement of her brand new home, Police are forced to use cutting edge techniques to solve a terrifying mystery.

programme.title: On the Case: Deceiving Appearances
programme.desc: Police suspect a mysterious double homicide is not what it appears to be.

programme.title: On the Case: Mixed Signals
programme.desc: Cell phone records may help solve the disturbing murder of a popular teenager.

programme.title: On the Case: Unfinished Journey
programme.desc: Jamie Bowie disappears while driving from Phoenix to Los Angeles on Interstate 10, then her body is found near the highway a month later.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Predator
programme.desc: A sexual predator viciously murders a 16 year old girl. Can investigators catch him before he kills again?

programme.title: On the Case: Dirty Secrets
programme.desc: How did seventeen year old Joanna Rogers disappear from her home in the middle of the night? It was a question that baffled the investigators in Lubbock, TX. The mystery may have never been solved without the evidence found during another brutal murder...

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Deception
programme.desc: Officers investigate the death of a father of four who was gunned down, however nothing about the crime is what it appears to be.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder at Sunrise
programme.desc: A beautiful young mother is found murdered while walking her dogs. Investigators suspect her killer is someone she knew. Twenty-six years latter police make an arrest but is he the right man?

programme.title: On the Case: A Mother's Nightmare
programme.desc: A young boy is murdered in his bed in the middle of the night. Police suspect the child's mother. Over the next 9 years there will be accusations, a confession and a conviction but will justice be served?

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Finish Line
programme.desc: A multi-stop mission to the Far North has Devan, Scott and Adam facing a series of white- knuckle obstacles.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ski Plane
programme.desc: Young pilots AJ and Andrew get the chance of a lifetime to fly the magnificent DC-3 specially equipped with skis to land on frozen strips.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Buffalo Scores
programme.desc: Buffalo scores the charter of a lifetime when they're asked to transport the Stanley Cup on a tour of the North. Cup fever spreads quickly around Buffalo, and for Mikey, what begins as an innocent love for this hockey icon soon becomes an obsession.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Chief Pilot Arnie lands the DC-3 on a homemade sand strip at a remote lodge. Electra expert Chuck goes one-on-one with a stubborn power unit, and Rod's wife Sasha goes into labour with the newest member of the McBryan family.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Yukon
programme.desc: When thunderstorms and a shaking engine threaten a DC-3 charter to Whitehorse, Joe pulls out all the stops to get the passengers to their destination.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Arnie Calls It
programme.desc: While training waterbomber captains for the upcoming fire-fighting season, Chief Pilot Arnie makes a surprising decision. AJ becomes a DC-4 captain and ponders whether to accept a promotion.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dambusters
programme.desc: Buffalo gets into the stunt flying business when veteran pilot Arnie flies the DC-4 for the re- enactment scene of a famous WWII bombing raid.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Chuck Walks
programme.desc: Critical of the many stops and starts in the Electra program, and frustrated with the constant drama at Buffalo, Chuck quits. Joe clashes with the maintenance department when a series of delays puts the sale of an old Canso waterbomber in jeopardy.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Gear Up, Gear Down
programme.desc: Frustrated with her lack of flying and stuck in a rut as a courier driver, Audrey decides her time at Buffalo is over.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Big Boost
programme.desc: When a ferry breakdown causes a gasoline shortage in Yellowknife, new manager Duane begs Chuck to return and prepare the Electra for a fuel haul.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Duane lands a huge contract for the Electra and puts enormous pressure on mechanic Adam to prep the plane without the help of his mentor Chuck.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Top of the World
programme.desc: The Electra flies to Alert, the northernmost settlement on Earth, forcing Adam and new senior manager Duane to work things out.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Last Days
programme.desc: Sparks fly when Joe discovers Gord has taken a job with a rival airline after completing expensive training on one of the Buffalo planes

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Push Comes to Shove
programme.desc: Trying to make his mark at Buffalo, Duane lands two more Electra contracts. But his over- zealous efforts result in a clash with the crew and with Joe, and a down-to-the-wire midnight departure to meet a deadline.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Doghouse
programme.desc: Duane's decision to leave the Electra crew unsupervised while he spends time at home jeopardizes the completion of a major contract, and could cost him his job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Strip
programme.desc: Mechanic Jimmy is sent to a northern mining camp to create an ice landing strip on a remote lake where AJ will have to land a DC-3 and the much bigger C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Expect the Unexpected
programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine. High winds wreak havoc for Devan and his crew on another C-46 mission to help clean up an oil spill in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Coming Home
programme.desc: Rookie waterbomber pilot Scott gets his first taste of action when Buffalo responds to an emergency callout to fight fires in Alberta. Mikey and Rod think they hit the jackpot when they buy a million dollar firefighting plane on eBay at a bargain price.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington
programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice
programme.desc: 1978 Williams Disco pinball machine; 1898 dice popper gambling device; talking 1990s bar top breathalyzer; deadly fishing harpoon.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
programme.desc: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sin City Shootout
programme.desc: 1953 Chevy-inspired bumper car; scores of M16 30-round magazines; reproduction 1940s boardwalk photobooth; aerosol-powered spud gun potato launchers.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat
programme.desc: All-terrain Air Commander Hovercraft, a 1970s NASA countdown clock and a one-of-a-kind 1960s Delta Relay rocket.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Drömskoveln
programme.desc: Pierre smyger efter dovhjort i Östergötland. Dag 2 ser han ett par dovskovlar. Efter en lyckad jakt tillagar han en smarrig lunch i skogen.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Skytteträning
programme.desc: Säsongen är igång och det är viktigare än nånsin att skyttet ligger på topp. Enjoy!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Johannishus drevjakt
programme.desc: Drevjakten som alla väntat på! Återigen besöker Jompen & Danne Johannishus för en makalöst bra drevjakt på vildsvin.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Ripjakt
programme.desc: Filip och fjälljägaren Oskar Öhrström ger sig ut på en fantastisk ripjakt i de jämtländska fjällen. Det blir ett roligt avsnitt med mycket action.

programme.title: Vilterian: Hare
programme.desc: I veckans avsnitt visar Tottie hur man tar vara på en hare och lagar en fantastisk rätt som ni måste testa!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Jakt I Almunge
programme.desc: Jompen åker till Uppland för att öva på drevjakt

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Skjutbio
programme.desc: Lubbe demonstrerar vikten av att träna på sina skyttefärdigheter.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Kikarsikten - Vad Ska Du Välja?
programme.desc: Jompen besöker Patrik och pratar lite om kikarsikten.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Musikhjälpen & Grisabocken
programme.desc: En av våra kära tittare köpte en jakt med oss via Musikhjälpen. Glada blev vi o alla andra involverande. Vildsvinsjakt va det vi bjussa på.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Rådjurswrap, Pierre Jagar Vidare I Tyskland & Jakt Med Wehunt
programme.desc: Jompen lagar rådjurswrap med pepparrotscreme.
programme.sub-title: Rådjurswrap, Pierre Jagar Vidare I Tyskland & Jakt Med Wehunt

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Kronhjort Och Vildsvinsjakt I Spanien & Ripjakt
programme.desc: Sista jaktdagen i Spanien. Vi jagar kronhjort och vildsvin.
programme.sub-title: Kronhjort Och Vildsvinsjakt I Spanien & Ripjakt

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Vi Testar Aimpoint Sikten
programme.desc: Jompen, Danne, Calle och Anders åker ner till Aimpoint i Skåne för att testa rödpunktssikte för första gången. Vad är fördelen med rödpunkt? Bör man byta till rödpunkt för drevjakter? Hur fungerar rödpunkt? Allt detta och mer besvaras.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Älgjakt
programme.desc: Jompen och Pierre åker på var sin älgjakt i Jämtland. Pierre prövar lyckan att gå som hundförare och Jompen står på pass.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Aska The Dog - Del 1 & 2
programme.desc: Valpen - Aska, en jakthunds resa.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Yakiniku På Vilt & Säljakt
programme.desc: Jompen o Calle brygger öl hos en kompis samtidigt som dom tillagar yakiniku o vårullar på viltkött, närmare bestämt vildsvin o rådjurskött.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Bewegungsjakt I Tyskland
programme.desc: Pierre åker till Tyskland tillsammans med Zeiss för drevjakt på vildsvin, kronhjort, mufflon och rådjur. Jakt är jakt filmar såklart och jaktformen som kallas bewegungsjakt blir mycket spännande!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Ser Älg Men Skjuter Dov!

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bunker, Pt. 1
programme.desc: The IMF races a paid killer who is stalking a nuclear scientist forced by the enemy to work on a device that could upset the world power balance in the first of a two-part episode.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bunker, Pt. 2
programme.desc: While trying to free a nuclear scientist and his wife from enemy hands, the IMF is trapped when a would-be assassin takes over one of Rollin's disguises in Part 2.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Nitro
programme.desc: The IMF finds itself only a second away from eternity when they intercept a nitroglycerine expert who plans to blow up the government house of a small country, thus provoking war with its neighbor nation.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Vault
programme.desc: Guest star Nehemiah Persoff as a corrupt Latin American official plots to loot his own country of $40,000,000 with the connivance of the IMF.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Nicole
programme.desc: Guest star Joan Collins, as a seductive double agent, endangers a vital IMF project when Jim Phelps falls in love with her.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Illusion
programme.desc: Cinnamon and Rollin become cabaret performers in a plot to get a deranged man (guest Fritz Weaver) to fall in love with Cinnamon, then kill her.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Interrogator
programme.desc: In a bold experiment with a man's mind, the IMF blanks out an enemy agent's memory (guest star Henry Silva), then sets out to make him think he is someone else.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Controllers (Part 1)
programme.desc: Leonard Nimoy and guest star Dina Merrill join the Impossible Missions Force to fight a mind-destroying drug that could enslave the free world in the first of a two-part episode.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Controllers (Part 2)
programme.desc: Jim Phelps lets himself be framed for murder in a scheme to discredit a scientist who has developed a mind-destroying drug in the second of a two-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Code
programme.desc: Leonard Nimoy becomes a member of the Impossible Missions Force and, as Paris of the IMF, helps crack a vital code by hijacking a plane so the enemy can capture one of the passengers

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Mastermind
programme.desc: In a battle with organized crime, the IMF sets up a bizarre mind-transfer experiment to convince a syndicate leader he is being double-crossed on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Numbers Game
programme.desc: Guest star Mai (cq) Britt is a dangerous obstacle when the IMF sets out to learn the number of her husband's Swiss hank account by convincing him World War III has started on Paramount Television Is "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Commandante
programme.desc: To free an imprisoned priest whose life is at stake, Jim Phelps poses as a missionary, Paris becomes a Chinese general and Barney builds a helicopter on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Robot
programme.desc: Lee Meriwether and Malachi Throne are guest stars in an IMF plot involving doubles and double-dealing, with Paris playing five different roles and Jim Phelps turning magician on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Fool's Gold
programme.desc: Musical comedy star Sally Ann Howes plays a dramatic role as a guest member of the IMF when it sets out to foil a plot to ruin a friendly country with counterfeit money on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Double Circle
programme.desc: Guest star Anne Francis joins the IMF when it sets out to prevent destruction of a secret formula vital to America's missile defense system on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Submarine
programme.desc: To locate a hoard of stolen money, the IMF takes the one man who knows its hiding place (guest star Stephen McNally) on a bizarre submarine voyage on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Dating Amber
programme.desc: Tenåringene Eddie og Amber vokste opp i en liten irsk småby på 1990-tallet. Alle mistenker at de er homofile, og hver dag er en kamp. De kommer sammen på late som og innser at et imaginært forhold kan være minst like komplisert som et ekte

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er lei av forholdet til kjæresten Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), en mega-fan av musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Når en akustisk demo av Tucks 25 år gamle plate plutselig dukker opp, fører dette til et møte med uventede konsekvenser.

programme.title: Benjamin
programme.desc: I Simon Amstells rørende, bittersøte komedie, blir en ung, fremadstormende filmskaper kastet inn i en emosjonell malstrøm av en spirende romanse og den kommende premieren på hans andre spillefilm.

programme.title: Reaching for the Moon
programme.desc: En kronikk om det tragiske kjærlighetsforholdet mellom den amerikanske poeten Elizabeth Bishop og den brasilianske arkitekten Lota de Macedo Soares.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: New York, 1921. Den polske kvinnen Ewa (Marion Cotillard) og hennes søster Magda seiler til Amerika i jakten på den amerikanske drøm og starten på et nytt liv. Men det skal vise seg at det nye livet blir krevende.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: ”Peace, Love & Misunderstanding” er et hjertevarmt portrett av en fargerik familie. Det som var ment bare å være en helgtur endrer seg raskt til å bli et sommereventyr fylt med romantikk, familiehemmeligheter, og det som trengs for å være lykkelig.

programme.title: A Kind of Magic
programme.desc: Hekserådet forventer at Matt skal gifte seg med heksen Lizzie, men han møter en annen – Sara. Da slutter hans magiske krefter å virke. Sara på sin side oppdager at hun har tatt imot dem.

programme.title: Sommersby
programme.desc: Richard Gere spiller Jack Sommersby, en mann som kommer hjem fra krigen for å gjenoppta livet sitt sju år etter at han ble antatt omkommet.

programme.title: Youth in Revolt
programme.desc: Michael Cera (SUPERBAD) spiller Nick Twisp. En unik, men elskverdig tenåring med en smak for de sofistikerte tingene i livet. Han forelsker seg i den nydelige og intelligente Sheeni Saunders (Portia Doubleday) på campingferie med familien.

programme.title: Streetdance
programme.desc: Vi følger en dansegruppe som trener hardt for å kunne konkurrere om seieren i det kommende, nasjonale streetdance mesterskapet. De har bare et problem, de mangler et sted hvor de kan øve.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: Når det kommer fram en mystisk, umerket videokassett på et lokalt åsted, forstår Rachel at Samara er tilbake og mer bestemt enn noensinne på å fortsette sin ustoppelige terror.

programme.title: Survival Of The Dead
programme.desc: På en isolert ø kriger rivaliserende grupper om hvordan de døde skal håndteres, mens zombiepesten fortsetter å spre seg.

programme.title: REC 2
programme.desc: En bygning er satt i karantene på grunn av en dødelig, ukjent virus. Kommer noen levende ut?

programme.title: The Jolly Monkey
programme.desc: For 40 år siden forsvant familier i nærheten av det isolerte Jolly Monkey-motellet. I dag vender eiernes familie tilbake for å diskutere hva de skal gjøre med stedet. Én etter én blir de drept av noen utkledd som motellets maskot og må flykte.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter
programme.desc: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.

programme.desc: Bob and Millie wake up to find they are in a strange town. Everything appears to be props - trees, animals even cars.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Come Wander with Me
programme.desc: A singer's song becomes tragically real.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
programme.desc: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: En kvinne flytter inn i et nabolag der en gruppe ektemenn har gjort konene sine til roboter som er designet for å ta vare på dem. Nyinnspilling av filmen fra 1975.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Walking Distance

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
programme.desc: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Robots
programme.desc: Walter, Cabe og Happy er fanget sammen med mannskapet i en topphemmelig ubåt når en eksplosjon sender den til bunnen av havet med begrenset oksygen og en selvdestruksjonsfunksjon som snart vil aktiveres.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Super Fun Guys
programme.desc: Team Scorpion går undercover på filmen "Super Fun Guy" satt i Kasakhstan for å deaktivere en sovjetisk atommissil som selges av terrorister.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Tech, Drugs, and Rock 'n Roll - Part 1
programme.desc: Walters forsøk på å "normalisere" går fryktelig galt når et virus lastes opp til datamaskinen hans, og gjør Team Scorpions nye "smarte" byggeprosjekt til en brennende dødsfelle med folk innelåst.
programme.sub-title: Tech, Drugs, and Rock 'n Roll - Part 1

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Tech, Drugs, and Rock 'n Roll - Part 2

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Area 51

programme.title: Scorpion NO: US vs. UN vs. UK

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Arrivals and Departures

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte rekkehuset sitt i den tro at de snart skulle finne det rette huset. Men sånn gikk det ikke. Paret er utrolig kresne, og har høye krav. Kan ekspertene skape hjemmet som Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 504

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en vakker herskapsleilighet på Frederiksberg med sine to barn. Men de vil ha mer plass i et barnevennlig nabolag, innom sykkelavstand fra sentrum. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finne et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 506
programme.desc: En liten leiebolig i Vanløse og to små barn - ikke den beste kombinasjonen. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med en stor hage. Tobias må jobbe hardt, da drømmene er mye større enn budsjettet.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark
programme.desc: Kristian drømmer om en diger garasje, og Nathja vil heller bli i Køge – kan Tobias oppfylle drømmene sine?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark
programme.desc: Maja og Kenneth bor på Vestjylland og drømmer om å komme nærmere familien til Maja i Silkeborg. Men budsjettet deres krever at de går på akkord med beliggenheten og ser i de nærliggende små byene.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 603
programme.desc: I Ikast er Camilla og Marc sultne på et hus med plass til oppbevaring. Men når Tobias finner et stort hus til dem, mister de motet, da det nå er SÅ mange rom som må pusses opp...

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 604
programme.desc: Stine og Daniel lengter etter mer plass før de snart utvider familien fra tre til fire. Derfor er det ikke optimalt når Mads ringer og forteller at avtalen med det nye huset deres i Langå ikke gjelder.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 301
programme.desc: Astrid og Steffen skal kjøpe sitt første hus, men de kan ikke gå på kompromiss med ønskene sine. De møter programmets eksperter som skal kjøpe et hus på deres vegne.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 302
programme.desc: Louise og Michael har vokst ut av sin lille leilighet i Århus og trenger mer plass. Paret gjør et kompromiss, og Louise står overfor sitt største mareritt i huset som ekspertene kjøper til dem.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 303
programme.desc: Charlotte og Mikkel bor i en så liten leilighet at dusjen må tømmes for ting hver gang de skal bade. Men nå ønsker de å flytte litt ut av byen sammen med sønnen deres.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 304
programme.desc: Pernille og Nicklas fra Odense bor så lite at hvis de trenger litt privatliv, så har de bare toalettet å ty til. Nicklas drømmer om å få et kjøkken med to ovner, slik at han kan lage mer mat.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 305
programme.desc: Wendy og Jesper fra Kalundborg bor allerede bra, i en leilighet som har en utrolig utsikt. Men en kommende familieforøkelse betyr at de må finne noe som er større.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 306
programme.desc: Jonas og Louise får sjokk når de ser hvilke hus de har råd til. Mads Mikkelsen og Tobias Edlev Nielsen jobber overtid for å prøve å oppfylle parets ønsker.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 307
programme.desc: Mads og Mia ønsker å flytte litt utenfor byen - men ikke helt på landet. Med Tobias og Mads sin hjelp kjøper de en bolig som har nøyaktig alt de ikke liker.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 401
programme.desc: I første episode møter vi Tine og Lars, som har svimlende åtte millioner å kjøpe hus og pusse opp for. Men det store budsjettet har ikke hjulpet dem så langt - kan ekspertene være til hjelp?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Pilot
programme.desc: I premiereepisoden prøver Don å fakke en serievoldtektsmann som har begynt å drepe ofrene sine. Don rekrutterer Charlie for å hjelpe til med å spore opp morderen.

programme.desc: Beruset for første gang i sitt liv, gjør en engstelig, vordende prest et amorøst fremstøt mot Diane, og han konkluderer med at han ikke er egnet for noe kloster.

programme.title: Cheers: The Spy Who Came In for a Cold One

programme.title: Cheers: Now Pitching, Sam Malone
